name: Along Came Treble
source:
Sick of being an intern at your music label, you jump at the chance to manage an A-list star... but will they be more treble than they're worth?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Along_Came_Treble]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你厌倦了在唱片公司当实习生，于是抓住了管理一线明星的机会……但他们的高音会比他们的价值更高吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Along_Came_Treble]Choices Wikia[/url]]
